_readme: Per language: 'missing' = keys the locale lacks (value = English source to translate); 'changed' = keys whose English text changed since your translation (en = new English, was = previous English, current = your existing translation to update). Placeholders like {n} must stay as they are. PROP.<ID>.the is the prop with a definite article ("the fireplace"), used when it is the only one on the board; until it is translated, clues keep the PROP.<ID>.a form.
